description: Saves a template as a draft, never published: renders keep using the published version until a person publishes the draft in Formfeed. With template and base_checksum it saves a new version of that template: read it with get_template_source first, change what the user asked for, and pass only the parts you changed (the others are kept from the version you read). With new_template and html it creates a template whose version 1 is the draft. change_note says what changed; the person reads it before publishing. Returns the saved version, the check of the draft with its sample data (fix every error and save again) and review_url, the page where the person reviews and publishes it: hand that to the user. Needs an API key with template:write, or, for a signed-in agent, the person's permission under Account → Connected agents in Formfeed. Word and PowerPoint templates cannot be saved here. Free; a new template counts towards the plan's template limit.

base_checksum.description: With template: the checksum get_template_source returned. When someone saved a newer version since, nothing is saved: read the source again and redo the change on it

change_note.description: What the draft changes, in one sentence, shown in the version history

data_schema.description: JSON Schema of data; null removes the stored one

data_sets.description: Named sample data sets besides sample_data (name → data)

head.description: Extra markup for <head>, such as font links

html.description: The body markup in the template language, without <html>, <head> or <body>; up to 2 MB

i18n.description: Translations: locale → key → text, read by the t helper

new_template.description: Creates a template whose version 1 is this draft; pass this and html, or template

kind.description: pdf for documents, image for pictures

slug.description: New in the workspace: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. invoice-de

sample_data.description: The data the editor previews with and the draft is checked with; never used by a render

settings.description: Paper, margins, header, footer, fonts and the other settings, as get_template_source returns them; replaces the stored settings as a whole

template.description: Slug or tpl_ id of the template to save a new draft of; pass this or new_template

name: save_template

part.description: Word and PowerPoint templates: the file part of the tag

path.description: Where in the data, for data errors

ok.description: false when the check of the draft found an error; null when the check could not run

review_url.description: The page in Formfeed where the person reviews and publishes the draft

published_version.description: The version renders still use; null when nothing is published yet

checksum.description: base_checksum for a further change to this draft

title: Save a template as a draft
